1. Standardized imports:

   - Checks if note file already exists before processing
   - Returns existing file path if found

6. Progress reporting improvements:
   - More granular progress updates
   - Better progress percentage distribution (5% for setup, 90% for processing, 5% for completion)
   - More informative progress messages
